03 / Behind the grid

Three signals, three different meanings. Google guest scores reflect reviews of one hotel. Hotel star classes describe that property’s classification as listed on Google. Editorial awards recognise selected hotels; brand-size rankings measure scale, not guest satisfaction.

Price snapshot, not a booking quote. Retrieved on 23 September 2026 from indexed Google Hotels pages. Each profile lists the dates exactly as shown (the year is not stated in the visible snapshot), the displayed nightly base, stay total, and number of nights. Guest count is shown only when available. Room type and cancellation terms for the headline quote were not verified. Recheck Google for your own dates and guests before booking. “Including taxes” means the taxes and fees included in Google’s displayed total, not a guarantee that all local charges are covered.
